subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and roll out these 14 new action revisions across secret-bearing, security-scanning, publishing, and repository-automation workflows?
rationale: The diff is mechanically sound, but deciding whether to trust replacement third-party execution at these permission boundaries requires repository-owner intent rather than automated judgment.

options.title: Approve verified revisions
options.body: Rebase, verify each SHA and relevant upstream behavior, and merge after exact-head workflow and security gates pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker, and CodeQL updates from routine toolchain setup bumps to narrow the trust review.

options.title: Hold existing revisions
options.body: Pause or close the batch if the privileged upstream changes cannot be reviewed confidently.

recommendation.title: Approve verified revisions
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify each SHA and relevant upstream behavior, and merge after exact-head workflow and security gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS directly assigns this security-sensitive workflow surface to steipete, and the timeline shows engagement with this PR.
